availability: Manual review accepted; no further approval required to seal Phase 4.

fixtures.basis: Phase 4 verified settings fixture; artificial delay extended from 300 to 3000 ms for manual announcement review only

findings.observation: Focus returns as expected for both Escape and X. Escape initially announces ", selected"; X clearly announces "Search Commands, popup Dialog...".
findings.evidence: In Chromium, Firefox and WebKit, Escape changes aria-expanded and removes aria-activedescendant while en-command-search is focused, before dialog.close restores trigger focus. Keyboard and pointer close-button activation perform those mutations after focus leaves the search field. All nine cases restore trigger focus and close the dialog.
findings.limitation: DOM tracing cannot establish spoken announcements or causal screen-reader behavior. Browser/screen-reader details and manual comparison remain pending.
findings.proposedFollowup: Test closing the accepted modal and restoring focus before clearing combobox ARIA state; preserve canceled closes and composition behavior. Retest exact announcement before claiming a fix.

failure-then-retry.scope: User acceptance of the failure-then-retry fixture workflow, including loading and failure announcements. Does not resolve the separate dismissal announcement finding.
